# ISSN position stands - master bibliography

Every reference cited across the 27 ISSN documents in this folder, deduplicated by PubMed ID and DOI.

**5192 unique references** from 6177 total citations. Sorted by how many stands cite them - a paper cited by several stands is doing more work than one cited once.
